statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope that are unexplained by standard evaluation
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis codes are R55 and I34.0
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan

A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is indicated for comprehensive rhythm analysis to determine if transient loss-of-consciousness events are driven by intermittent arrhythmias associated with the valvular pathology
